title: Caption Lanes
user: Deaf and hard-of-hearing people in small in-person groups who need to know which person a live caption belongs to without reading one merged text wall.
smallest_useful_product: Android app for tabletop conversations that renders separate caption lanes and coarse left/center/right direction from the phone microphone array; users can lock a lane color or hide low-confidence text. Non-goals: identity/voiceprint recognition, cloud meeting archives, or forensic audio capture.
success_measure: In a four-person test, participants correctly attribute at least 80% of 30 short utterances while reading captions.
monetization: freemium — a free two-speaker offline mode validates value; a paid multi-device microphone/accessory mode can fund hardware support.
constraints: Communicate direction confidence and microphone limits; process audio locally; obtain consent; do not infer identity or retain raw audio.
